quote.text: For every complex problem there is an answer that is clear, simple, and wrong.
quote.author: H. L. Mencken, Prejudices: Second Series (1920)

stories.kicker: Iran & the Gulf · The diplomacy dies at sea
stories.headline: The Muscat accord collapses with a tanker hit off Oman — and the first crack in the oil story is the demand side
stories.dek: The temporary-transit deal that was to be signed on Monday never was; a commercial vessel was attacked in the strait, one crew member killed. Then, with Brent above a hundred and seven, the IEA and OPEC both cut their forecasts — the bear case arrives before the barrels run out.

stories.headline: The glass, from the melt up: what you are really paying for when a wine glass costs eighty dollars
stories.dek: Lead versus titanium crystal, a pulled stem versus a joined one, a laser-cut rim you cannot feel — the mechanism is simple. The theatre begins the moment a maker sells you a different glass for every grape.

stories.kicker: Down the Rabbit Hole · Metal detecting & mudlarking
stories.headline: History you can hold: the coil, the foreshore, and the jolt of the first hammered coin
stories.dek: One is swinging an electromagnetic coil over a field; the other is reading a tidal riverbank at low water. Both promise the same thing — a thing no one has touched for centuries — and both are governed by a surprising amount of law.

stories.kicker: Air quality · The whole island, at once
stories.headline: The haze turns unhealthy in every direction — the first islandwide reading since 2019
stories.dek: At dawn on Monday every region crossed into the unhealthy band, Central worst at a hundred and fifty-four. The schools have their purifiers running; the growth forecasters, oddly, chose the same week to raise their call to five per cent.

stories.headline: The AI-chip trade cracks on a “pacing” fear — days after Nvidia agreed to buy Hugging Face outright
stories.dek: A single session wiped the better part of two hundred billion off Nvidia as the debate over how fast the buildout can go spread from memory into logic. The strategic move underneath it: Nvidia buying the open-model town square for thirteen billion.

stories.kicker: Gear We’re Watching · Headphones as a system node
stories.headline: Sonos puts a whole system on your head — and asks you to trust the app one more time
stories.dek: The Ace Ultra adds a new forty-millimetre driver, thirty-five hours of battery and, the real differentiator, a direct Wi-Fi link into a Sonos home — four hundred and forty-nine dollars, general sale on the twenty-ninth.

stories.kicker: Objects & Escapes · The dial that lost its clutter
stories.headline: Orient Star drops the power-reserve hand it has carried since 1996 — and lets the dial breathe
stories.dek: For its seventy-fifth anniversary the Sakigake Three Hand strips the date and the power-reserve indicator for a clean, symmetrical face and a new in-house movement. Around eight hundred and eighty euros. You are paying for the look, not the chronometry.

stories.kicker: Culture Desk · The widest split of the year
stories.headline: A witch sequel opens number one with a thirty-six from the critics and a ninety-plus from the fans
stories.dek: “Practical Magic 2” reunited its stars, topped the weekend, and split the room down the middle — a case study in who actually buys a ticket in 2026.

stories.kicker: Raising Them Well · The Secondary-1 conversation
stories.headline: The drug-laced vape, not the nicotine one, is the talk to have before Secondary 1
stories.dek: Etomidate “Kpods” are a sedative in a vape shell, and Singapore has spent the year moving them from the poisons list to the drug list. The numbers are real, the panic is optional — and, new this month, there is finally a treatment door beside the enforcement one. General guidance, not medical advice.

stories.kicker: The Big Picture · The hike into the shock
stories.headline: A rate rise the Fed does not want, into an oil shock it cannot fix
stories.dek: The market prices a nine-in-ten chance of the first US hike since 2023 when the decision lands early Thursday here. The ten-year has touched five per cent; gold makes records; bitcoin, tellingly, does not. Market explanation, not investment advice.

stories.kicker: The Long Game · The strength sweet spot
stories.headline: Ninety to a hundred and twenty minutes of lifting a week — and nothing extra to be had past it
stories.dek: A thirty-year, 147,000-person study puts a number on resistance training and death — and the number plateaus early. Pair it with a zone-2 base rather than choosing one. General guidance, not medical advice.

stories.kicker: What’s Worth Booking · The dated agenda
stories.headline: A Grand Prix with its first Sprint, a snow slope counting down, and a sumo that goes on sale Saturday
stories.dek: The autumn calendar is loaded; the one to act on this week is Fukuoka’s November basho, tickets on the nineteenth.

stories.headline: Financial fast food: how Mongolia’s app-loan boom quietly became a way to buy dinner
stories.dek: The world looks at Mongolia’s copper and coal. It should look at the loan apps multiplying “like mushrooms after rain” — and at a pensioner whose entire pension now services a debt.
